pages.text: Rain born of accumulated resentment and blight. Its drops are not pure blue, but a tainted grey-red. For those without a priestess's blood, this rain is deadly.
pages.title: Blighted Rain

pages.text: Some creatures transform into their blighted counterparts after prolonged exposure. Blighted creatures may drop unique materials, and their attacks become stronger. Face them with caution…
Blight has infected the world. Even when the Blighted Rain subsides, the curtain of rain goes on without end.
